title: The body of one Beehive release, speech, feature or page, as the query-nz ingest MCP's beehive record carries it (`body_text`), read by the text reader for every person and body it names

landmarks: a record of profile mcp-beehive-record (a JSON object with `id` and `url` under https://www.beehive.govt.nz/)
`body_text`: a non-empty string of at least 20 whitespace words (the record's own `word_count` is that count)
`title` (empty on every feature and some pages; the reader is given it where it is), `type` in release, speech, feature, page

signals.measured_on: every row of pub.beehive_releases on 31 October 2026 (registers/beehive, beehive-2): 66,588 rows, 66,571 MCP records (66,572 distinct documents), 17 old-estate rows read from the once-only export (not records: not read by this profile)

signals_note: Recognised from the record's fields without reading: the lane's reader (read.recognise) says it is a beehive record, and model_read.recognise_body says the body is there and long enough. A record with no body or under 20 words is set aside at stage read with the reason, no model called. The site's tagged ministers (release_ministers) are the site's rows and are not re-read.
prompt: Read by the text reader (registers.beehive.model_read, Flash-Next, scheduler profile text-reader, temperature 0, thinking off): the title and body (head 28,000 and tail 4,000 characters when long) to one JSON object: a one-line summary and every person and body named with kind (person, company, agency, body, place), role (minister, member of parliament, official, chief executive, chair, board member, appointee, recipient, award, spokesperson, speaker, organisation, mentioned, other), the role in the text's words, and the organisation a person is of. The prompt is the module's PROMPT, its hash in the reading's settings; two attempts, then set aside with the reason.
notes: One reading per document hash in the reader store, replayed by the load (beehive.people, beehive.releases.summary) and never re-derived (ruling 50). A name is a name as printed: never a link, never a claim; the links lane reads pub.beehive_people (ruling 123).
